note: Levels are cumulative: a game at level N applies every level from 1 to N. Level 0 = no destination rules.

destinations.name: The Verdant Reach
destinations.flavor: A garden world around a quiet star. It needs living colonists.

levels.text: Landfall requirement: at least 5 Crew per player. Hazard, Spore Drift: when Grow adds a Fault in an Agricultural section, also add 1 Glitch to its least-threatened adjacent section.
Setup: +1 Fault in one Agricultural section on each board.
Escalation: add 1 Glitch to every Agricultural section.
Setup: +1 Fault in every Agricultural section that has none.
Hazard, Blight Season: each Collapse in an Agricultural section destroys 2 additional Crew. Landfall requirement rises to 6 Crew per player.
Deck: one Stage I card is replaced by an extra Stage III card.

destinations.name: Cinder
destinations.flavor: A world scorched by solar flares. The hull takes the brunt of the approach.

levels.text: Landfall requirement: no Decay in Infrastructure sections.
Setup: +1 Glitch in every Outer Hull section.
Escalation: add 1 Glitch and 1 Unrest to every Outer Hull section that has threat, and 1 Glitch to every other Outer Hull section.
Hazard, Flare: each Outer Hull section that is seeded gains 1 extra Glitch.
Setup: +1 Decay in one Outer Hull section on each board (not from the pool).
Hazard, Radiation: each Collapse in an Outer Hull section deals +1 damage.

destinations.name: The Long Dark
destinations.flavor: A rogue planet far from any star. The journey is long and belief wears thin.

levels.text: Landfall requirement: Understanding III. Hazard, The Cold: lose 1 Purpose at the start of each Day. Deck: +1 Stage II card (a longer journey).
Setup: +1 Fault in every Government section.
Hazard: The Cold now drains 2 Purpose each Day.
Setup: +1 Failure in one Residential section on each board.
Deck: one fewer Stage I card.
